event.description: Keep only the second attention head with learned residual projection
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 15 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0020 at 3,168 parameters/99.94%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0124, whose value-shared two-head candidate scored 0.00% at 1,593 parameters. The nearest directly comparable failed result is attempt-0113, which kept only the first head and scored 0.00% at 1,465 parameters. Hypothesis: the two learned heads may be asymmetric and the second may carry the essential carry-routing pattern. Retain its Q/K/V rows, add an 8x16 learned output projection initialized into the second residual half, and share both across depth, yielding 1,465 parameters. This is more informative than another mixed head-sharing scheme because it is the exact untested categorical complement of attempt-0113; after it, single-head deletion is closed. Causal softmax and generic decoding remain intact.
